19	# 论文写作风格规范
20	
21	> 核心哲学：**论文是一个有说服力的故事，不是实验报告。** 审稿人在几十秒内判断论文价值——如果 Abstract 和 Introduction 读起来像实验日志，论文就已经失败了。
22	
23	---
24	
25	## 一、总体写作哲学
26	
27	### 1.1 故事驱动，不是数据堆砌
28	
29	- 论文必须以"故事线"为核心展开：问题 → 洞察 → 方法 → 验证
30	- 禁止大量实验数据堆砌——每个数字出现必须服务于叙事推进
31	- 附录内容必须在正文中有明确引用且融入叙事，禁止简单堆砌
32	- 如果附录数据对核心叙事有重大影响，根据附录数据调整论文 framing
33	
34	### 1.2 主线统一性
35	
36	- 当 idea 在研究过程中发生变化后，**必须重审全文逻辑**
37	- 常见问题：Introduction 讲的故事 A，Method 做的是故事 B，Results 又在讲故事 C
38	- 修复方式：从最终实验结论反推，重写 Introduction 的问题定义和动机
39	- 每次 idea 调整后检查：Abstract → Introduction → Method → Results → Discussion → Conclusion 是否形成一条连贯主线
40	
41	### 1.3 专有名词必须有定义
42	
43	- 首次出现的专有名词/缩写必须给出完整定义和解释
44	- Abstract 中使用的缩写也必须在 Abstract 内定义（如 LLM = Large Language Model）
45	- 不能假设读者知道你自己定义的术语——论文从来没解释过的概念不能直接使用
46	- 通用规则：如果一个非标准术语第一次出现时没有括号定义，就是写作 bug
47	
48	### 1.4 写作前必读同类优秀论文
49	
50	- 每个章节动笔前，找 **2-3 篇目标会议近 1-2 年的高分论文**作为风格参考——同类问题或同类方法皆可
51	- 重点学：
52	  - Abstract 怎么用最少篇幅讲完故事
53	  - Introduction 怎么从大问题切入到具体贡献
54	  - Related Work 怎么 positioning 自己（不是 survey）
55	  - Table/Figure 怎么压缩信息密度
56	- **不是抄袭**，是学习同行的故事节奏和审美——不同子领域叙事节奏差异很大
57	- 实操：Paper Agent 可以从 `literature_map.yaml` 中挑 `role=foundation` 或 `role=direct-competitor` 的论文，把 `{title, venue, year, abstract}` 附在 Worker 的 task_prompt 中作为概念参考；如需学习写作风格本身，让 Worker 通过 WebSearch 取得论文链接并 fetch 全文
58	
59	---
60	
61	## 二、Abstract 写作规范
62	
63	### 2.1 四个必答问题（150-250 words）
64	
65	Abstract 必须在很短的篇幅内清楚回答：
66	1. **研究什么问题** — 1-2 句话交代背景和痛点
67	2. **为什么重要** — 现有方法的不足（不用写太多）
68	3. **本文提出什么** — 核心贡献的关键机制（简要，不堆砌细节）
69	4. **结果说明什么** — 用具体实验结论支撑贡献
70	
71	### 2.2 禁忌
72	
73	- **禁止堆砌数据**：Abstract 不是 Results 的缩写。最多引用 2-3 个关键数字，要服务于 claim
74	- **禁止过度宣传**：不说 "revolutionary"、"groundbreaking"
75	- **禁止写成 Introduction 的缩写**：Abstract 是独立阅读单元
76	- **禁止术语堆积**：如果审稿人几十秒内判断不出价值，就失败了
77	- **缩写必须定义**：Abstract 中首次出现的缩写必须展开
78	
79	### 2.3 审稿人视角检验
80	
81	写完后用这个标准自检：审稿人能否在 30 秒内判断——
82	- 问题是否重要？
83	- 方法是否清楚？
84	- 贡献是否可信？
85	- 结果是否有说服力？
86	
87	---
88	
89	## 三、Introduction 写作规范
90	
91	### 3.1 完整叙事线（5 段结构）
92	
93	Introduction 需要从一个清晰、重要的问题切入，逐步把读者带到核心贡献：
94	
95	1. **研究背景**（1-2 段）：大模型在某类能力/应用中已取得进展，但仍存在一个关键瓶颈
96	2. **问题重要性**（1 段）：结合真实应用、已有方法局限或当前趋势，说明这不是小问题
97	3. **现有方法不足**（1 段）：系统梳理为什么不够（依赖更大模型/更多数据/更复杂推理/更高成本，或只在特定 benchmark 有效）
98	4. **本文核心想法**（1 段）：我们观察到什么、提出了什么方法、为什么能解决上述问题
99	5. **贡献总结**（列表）：清楚列出方法贡献、实验贡献和分析贡献
100	
101	### 3.2 整体叙事结构
102	
103	```
104	现有进展 → 关键缺口 → 本文洞察 → 方法概述 → 实验证据 → 贡献总结
105	```
106	
107	### 3.3 禁忌
108	
109	- **禁止泛泛介绍**：不要开头就写 "LLMs have shown remarkable capabilities..."，要从具体问题切入
110	- **禁止缺少过渡**：每段之间必须有逻辑连接
111	- **禁止实验报告风格**：Introduction 不是 "我们做了 X 实验得到了 Y 结果" 的罗列
112	- 每条 Contribution 必须有对应的 section/table 支撑
113	- Contribution 列表中不能出现未在前文铺垫过的概念
114	
115	---
116	
117	## 四、Related Work 写作规范
118	
119	### 4.1 目标
120	
121	让审稿人相信：作者理解这个领域，知道自己的方法站在什么位置，清楚相对已有工作的真实增量在哪里。
122	
123	### 4.2 结构要求
124	
125	- 把已有工作分成几个清晰的主题（如模型训练、推理增强、工具调用、数据构建、评测等）
126	- 每类简要说明：已有方法做了什么、解决了哪些问题、和本文的关系
127	- 帮助读者理解：哪些是本文直接继承的，哪些方法不同但解决相似问题，哪些留下了本文要解决的缺口
128	
129	### 4.3 禁忌
130	
131	- **禁止论文堆砌**：不要写成 "A proposed X. B proposed Y. C proposed Z." 的列表
132	- **目标不是展示读了多少论文**，而是做归纳和比较
133	- Contribution claim（"To our knowledge, no prior work..."）应放在 Introduction，不在 Related Work
134	
135	### 4.4 引用充足度
136	
137	- 引用必须覆盖：**直接相关方法、baseline 论文、评测 benchmark 论文、理论基础**
138	- 任何一类缺失，审稿人会立刻看出来调研不充分
139	- 引用密度参照目标会议近年录用论文的量级——明显偏少意味着 Related Work 调研不足
140	
141	---
142	
143	## 五、去 AI 写作风格（硬规则）
144	
145	以下模式是 AI 生成文本的典型标志，审稿人一眼能看出。**必须全部消除。**
146	
147	### 5.1 严禁破折号（最显著的 AI 痕迹）
148	
149	**这是 AI 写作最容易被识别的标志，审稿人最敏感。单列为最高优先级硬规则。**
150	
151	- 解释性 em-dash（—，U+2014）和 en-dash（–，U+2013）必须**全部删除**
152	- 替代方式：用逗号、括号或拆分为两个句子
153	- 强制检查命令：
154	  ```bash
155	  grep -n "—" paper/*.tex     # em-dash，每处人工判断是否必要
156	  grep -n " – " paper/*.tex   # 解释性 en-dash，几乎都应删除
157	  ```
158	- 例外（允许保留）：表格分隔符、数字范围（`2020–2024`、`pp. 12–18`）、专有名词（`Newton–Raphson`）
159	
160	### 5.2 段落与句式
161	
162	- **禁止过度分段**：不需要每 2-3 句就换段，自然段 5-8 句是正常的
163	- **减少关系从句**（which, that, who）：能用简洁直接的句子就不用从句
164	- **禁止 -ing 短语结尾**：如 "..., highlighting the applicability of..." / "..., demonstrating the effectiveness of..."。这是 AI 写作最典型的标志之一
165	- **禁止连续使用 "Furthermore" / "Moreover" / "Additionally"**：一段内最多用一个过渡词
166	- **避免 "It is worth noting that..." / "Notably, ..."**：直接写要说的内容
167	
168	### 5.3 用词黑名单
169	
170	- 避免 "delve into" / "leverage" / "utilize" / "facilitate" — 用 "explore" / "use" / "enable"
171	- 避免 "a myriad of" / "a plethora of" — 用 "many" / "various"
172	- 避免 "in the realm of" / "in the context of" — 直接说
173	- 避免 "paradigm shift" / "novel" 过度使用
174	
175	### 5.4 校对清单（4 步）
176	
177	1. 全文 proofread 语法和拼写
178	2. 检查所有代词/指示词（this, that, it）是否指代明确
179	3. **`grep "—"` + `grep " – "` 全文清零**（删除所有解释性 dash，§5.1）
180	4. `grep "ing,"` 模式——大部分 -ing 分词短语需要改写
181	
182	---
183	
184	## 六、图表与视觉规范
185	
186	### 6.1 知识密度原则
187	
188	- **图表的信息必须紧凑**——不能为了美观而留大量白空间
189	- 一张图如果只传达一个简单信息，要么缩小要么合并到其他图中
190	- 能用 inline text 说清的不要占一整个 Figure
191	
192	### 6.2 表格规范
193	
194	- 表格和正文文字不能视觉重叠（检查 column 宽度和 alignment）
195	- 小数精度全表统一
196	- 最优加粗、次优下划线
197	- Caption 必须自包含
198	
199	### 6.3 图片规范
200	
201	- 数值标签不能被线、bar、点遮住——用白色背景或偏移标签
202	- 图中字体 >= 7pt（打印后仍可读）
203	- 栏宽约束需匹配目标 venue 模板要求
204	- 概念图/流程图要有信息量，不要画一个 trivial 的 pipeline 然后占半页
205	
206	### 6.4 空间效率
207	
208	- 顶会正文页数严格受限（具体页数查目标会议官网），每 cm² 都是宝贵资源
209	- 优先使用 `\subfigure` 合并相关图
210	- Table 能 inline 就不要单独浮动
211	- 图表占比与其对叙事的贡献成正比
212	
213	### 6.5 页面节奏
214	
215	好论文的页面有节奏感——text、equation、figure 交替出现，读者视觉不疲劳：
216	
217	- **text-equation-figure 三重奏**：重要概念用"文字解释 → 公式定义 → 图表直觉"三步展开
218	- 连续 2 页纯文本（无 figure/equation/table）→ 穿插一个 display item 打破节奏
219	- 连续 2 个 figure 页（整页被 float 占满）→ 至少隔 1 段文字再放下一个 float
220	- Section heading 不孤悬页底（heading 后至少跟 2 行正文，否则强制分页）
221	- 最后一页内容 ≥ 2/3 页面高度（太空显得凑数，太满放不下 references）
222	
223	### 6.6 表格 LaTeX 规范
224	
225	**Booktabs 标准（硬规则）**：
226	- 用 `\toprule` / `\midrule` / `\bottomrule`，禁止 `\hline`，禁止竖线 `|`
227	- 用 `\centering` 不用 `\begin{center}`（后者多加垂直空白）
228	- 最优结果加粗（`\textbf{}`），次优下划线（`\underline{}`）+ 方向箭头 `↑`/`↓` 标明指标方向
229	- 小数精度全表统一（如全部保留 1 位或 2 位）
230	- Caption 在表格上方（`\caption` 在 `\begin{tabular}` 之前）
231	
232	**宽度决策树**：
233	- ≤5 列 → 单栏宽度（`\columnwidth`）
234	- 6–8 列 → 全文宽度（`\textwidth`，双栏模板用 `table*`）
235	- >8 列 → 拆成两张表或移入 appendix
236	
237	---
238	
239	## 七、投稿前通用准备
240	
241	### 7.1 模板必须官方（硬规则）
242	
243	- LaTeX 模板**必须从目标会议官网下载**（CallForPapers / Author Instructions 页面）
244	- **不要用**：
245	  - 网上他人转载的复制版本（可能被改过 margin / 行号设置）
246	  - 上一年的模板（参数可能变：字体、margin、行号、anonymous 选项等）
247	  - 组里学长留的旧版本（来源不明、无法追溯）
248	- 风险：
249	  - 样式不符合 → desk reject
250	  - margin 不对 → 被审稿人质疑诚信
251	  - reference 格式错 → 被认为不规范
252	- 流程：先查会议官网 templates → 找不到再 `WebSearch "{venue} {year} latex template official"` → 仍找不到汇报 Director（不要用就近年版本顶替）
253	- `\documentclass[]{}` 选项必须与目标 venue + 阶段（review / camera-ready）一致
254	
255	### 7.2 投稿要求逐项核对
256	
257	- 目标会议如要求 Checklist / Ethical Statement / Broader Impact Statement / Reproducibility Statement，必须**认真填每一项**，不要全写 N/A
258	- 页数限制：查目标会议官网
259	- 匿名化要求：review 版 vs camera-ready 版本设置不同
260	- 行号开启（review 版常需）
261	- 字体大小、margin 不得修改 sty 文件
262	
263	### 7.3 最终修改 10 项检查流程
264	
265	提交前必须逐一检查：
266	1. 所有最新实验结果已全部录入
267	2. 根据实验结果将叙事调至最优状态
268	3. 附录所有内容在正文中被引用且融入叙事
269	4. 无数据堆砌（每个数字服务于叙事推进）
270	5. Abstract 和 Introduction 具有吸引力（不是实验报告风格）
271	6. 全文主线统一（idea 变化后各章节逻辑一致）
272	7. 所有专有名词有定义
273	8. 无 AI 风格标志（dash、-ing phrases、过度分段）
274	9. 图表知识密度高、无视觉遮挡
275	10. Reference 覆盖直接相关方法、baseline、benchmark、理论基础

## 二、Abstract 写作规范

- 方法是否清楚？
- 贡献是否可信？
- 结果是否有说服力？

---

## 三、Introduction 写作规范

### 3.1 完整叙事线（5 段结构）

Introduction 需要从一个清晰、重要的问题切入，逐步把读者带到核心贡献：

1. **研究背景**（1-2 段）：大模型在某类能力/应用中已取得进展，但仍存在一个关键瓶颈
2. **问题重要性**（1 段）：结合真实应用、已有方法局限或当前趋势，说明这不是小问题
3. **现有方法不足**（1 段）：系统梳理为什么不够（依赖更大模型/更多数据/更复杂推理/更高成本，或只在特定 benchmark 有效）
4. **本文核心想法**（1 段）：我们观察到什么、提出了什么方法、为什么能解决上述问题
5. **贡献总结**（列表）：清楚列出方法贡献、实验贡献和分析贡献

### 3.2 整体叙事结构

```
现有进展 → 关键缺口 → 本文洞察 → 方法概述 → 实验证据 → 贡献总结
```

### 3.3 禁忌

- **禁止泛泛介绍**：不要开头就写 "LLMs have shown remarkable capabilities..."，要从具体问题切入
- **禁止缺少过渡**：每段之间必须有逻辑连接
- **禁止实验报告风格**：Introduction 不是 "我们做了 X 实验得到了 Y 结果" 的罗列
- 每条 Contribution 必须有对应的 section/table 支撑
- Contribution 列表中不能出现未在前文铺垫过的概念

---

## 四、Related Work 写作规范

### 4.1 目标

让审稿人相信：作者理解这个领域，知道自己的方法站在什么位置，清楚相对已有工作的真实增量在哪里。

### 4.2 结构要求

- 把已有工作分成几个清晰的主题（如模型训练、推理增强、工具调用、数据构建、评测等）
- 每类简要说明：已有方法做了什么、解决了哪些问题、和本文的关系
- 帮助读者理解：哪些是本文直接继承的，哪些方法不同但解决相似问题，哪些留下了本文要解决的缺口

### 4.3 禁忌

- **禁止论文堆砌**：不要写成 "A proposed X. B proposed Y. C proposed Z." 的列表
- **目标不是展示读了多少论文**，而是做归纳和比较
- Contribution claim（"To our knowledge, no prior work..."）应放在 Introduction，不在 Related Work

### 4.4 引用充足度

- 引用必须覆盖：**直接相关方法、baseline 论文、评测 benchmark 论文、理论基础**
- 任何一类缺失，审稿人会立刻看出来调研不充分
- 引用密度参照目标会议近年录用论文的量级——明显偏少意味着 Related Work 调研不足

---

## 五、去 AI 写作风格（硬规则）

以下模式是 AI 生成文本的典型标志，审稿人一眼能看出。**必须全部消除。**

### 5.1 严禁破折号（最显著的 AI 痕迹）

**这是 AI 写作最容易被识别的标志，审稿人最敏感。单列为最高优先级硬规则。**

- 解释性 em-dash（—，U+2014）和 en-dash（–，U+2013）必须**全部删除**
- 替代方式：用逗号、括号或拆分为两个句子
- 强制检查命令：
  ```bash
  grep -n "—" paper/*.tex     # em-dash，每处人工判断是否必要
  grep -n " – " paper/*.tex   # 解释性 en-dash，几乎都应删除
  ```
- 例外（允许保留）：表格分隔符、数字范围（`2020–2024`、`pp. 12–18`）、专有名词（`Newton–Raphson`）

### 5.2 段落与句式

- **禁止过度分段**：不需要每 2-3 句就换段，自然段 5-8 句是正常的
- **减少关系从句**（which, that, who）：能用简洁直接的句子就不用从句
- **禁止 -ing 短语结尾**：如 "..., highlighting the applicability of..." / "..., demonstrating the effectiveness of..."。这是 AI 写作最典型的标志之一
- **禁止连续使用 "Furthermore" / "Moreover" / "Additionally"**：一段内最多用一个过渡词
- **避免 "It is worth noting that..." / "Notably, ..."**：直接写要说的内容

### 5.3 用词黑名单

- 避免 "delve into" / "leverage" / "utilize" / "facilitate" — 用 "explore" / "use" / "enable"
- 避免 "a myriad of" / "a plethora of" — 用 "many" / "various"
- 避免 "in the realm of" / "in the context of" — 直接说
- 避免 "paradigm shift" / "novel" 过度使用

### 5.4 校对清单（4 步）

1. 全文 proofread 语法和拼写
2. 检查所有代词/指示词（this, that, it）是否指代明确
3. **`grep "—"` + `grep " – "` 全文清零**（删除所有解释性 dash，§5.1）
4. `grep "ing,"` 模式——大部分 -ing 分词短语需要改写

---

## 六、图表与视觉规范

### 6.1 知识密度原则

- **图表的信息必须紧凑**——不能为了美观而留大量白空间
- 一张图如果只传达一个简单信息，要么缩小要么合并到其他图中
- 能用 inline text 说清的不要占一整个 Figure

### 6.2 表格规范

- 表格和正文文字不能视觉重叠（检查 column 宽度和 alignment）
- 小数精度全表统一
- 最优加粗、次优下划线
- Caption 必须自包含

### 6.3 图片规范

- 数值标签不能被线、bar、点遮住——用白色背景或偏移标签
- 图中字体 >= 7pt（打印后仍可读）
- 栏宽约束需匹配目标 venue 模板要求
- 概念图/流程图要有信息量，不要画一个 trivial 的 pipeline 然后占半页

### 6.4 空间效率

- 顶会正文页数严格受限（具体页数查目标会议官网），每 cm² 都是宝贵资源
- 优先使用 `\subfigure` 合并相关图
- Table 能 inline 就不要单独浮动
- 图表占比与其对叙事的贡献成正比

### 6.5 页面节奏

好论文的页面有节奏感——text、equation、figure 交替出现，读者视觉不疲劳：

- **text-equation-figure 三重奏**：重要概念用"文字解释 → 公式定义 → 图表直觉"三步展开
- 连续 2 页纯文本（无 figure/equation/table）→ 穿插一个 display item 打破节奏
- 连续 2 个 figure 页（整页被 float 占满）→ 至少隔 1 段文字再放下一个 float
- Section heading 不孤悬页底（heading 后至少跟 2 行正文，否则强制分页）
- 最后一页内容 ≥ 2/3 页面高度（太空显得凑数，太满放不下 references）

### 6.6 表格 LaTeX 规范

**Booktabs 标准（硬规则）**：
- 用 `\toprule` / `\midrule` / `\bottomrule`，禁止 `\hline`，禁止竖线 `|`
- 用 `\centering` 不用 `\begin{center}`（后者多加垂直空白）
- 最优结果加粗（`\textbf{}`），次优下划线（`\underline{}`）+ 方向箭头 `↑`/`↓` 标明指标方向
- 小数精度全表统一（如全部保留 1 位或 2 位）
- Caption 在表格上方（`\caption` 在 `\begin{tabular}` 之前）

**宽度决策树**：
- ≤5 列 → 单栏宽度（`\columnwidth`）
- 6–8 列 → 全文宽度（`\textwidth`，双栏模板用 `table*`）
- >8 列 → 拆成两张表或移入 appendix

---

## 七、投稿前通用准备

### 7.1 模板必须官方（硬规则）

- LaTeX 模板**必须从目标会议官网下载**（CallForPapers / Author Instructions 页面）
- **不要用**：
  - 网上他人转载的复制版本（可能被改过 margin / 行号设置）
  - 上一年的模板（参数可能变：字体、margin、行号、anonymous 选项等）
  - 组里学长留的旧版本（来源不明、无法追溯）
- 风险：
  - 样式不符合 → desk reject
  - margin 不对 → 被审稿人质疑诚信
  - reference 格式错 → 被认为不规范
- 流程：先查会议官网 templates → 找不到再 `WebSearch "{venue} {year} latex template official"` → 仍找不到汇报 Director（不要用就近年版本顶替）
- `\documentclass[]{}` 选项必须与目标 venue + 阶段（review / camera-ready）一致

### 7.2 投稿要求逐项核对

- 目标会议如要求 Checklist / Ethical Statement / Broader Impact Statement / Reproducibility Statement，必须**认真填每一项**，不要全写 N/A
- 页数限制：查目标会议官网
- 匿名化要求：review 版 vs camera-ready 版本设置不同
- 行号开启（review 版常需）
- 字体大小、margin 不得修改 sty 文件

### 7.3 最终修改 10 项检查流程

提交前必须逐一检查：
1. 所有最新实验结果已全部录入
2. 根据实验结果将叙事调至最优状态
3. 附录所有内容在正文中被引用且融入叙事
4. 无数据堆砌（每个数字服务于叙事推进）
5. Abstract 和 Introduction 具有吸引力（不是实验报告风格）
6. 全文主线统一（idea 变化后各章节逻辑一致）
7. 所有专有名词有定义
8. 无 AI 风格标志（dash、-ing phrases、过度分段）
9. 图表知识密度高、无视觉遮挡
10. Reference 覆盖直接相关方法、baseline、benchmark、理论基础

\section{Results}
\label{sec:results}

\subsection{Main Results}
\label{sec:main_results}

We report mean and standard deviation across $N$ seeds per condition, with 50 rollouts per task (500 total episodes per seed). Given the limited seed counts (2--4 per condition), we report effect directions and magnitudes but note that formal significance requires additional replications. All results use the 50{,}000-step checkpoint unless noted otherwise.

Table~\ref{tab:main_results} summarizes overall TSR and CAR across conditions. Four patterns emerge.

\textbf{Gradient flow is necessary to prevent auxiliary-head degradation.} Adding an auxiliary head with gradient flow yields CAR comparable to Vanilla: Full OCC (0.797, 3 seeds) and Random OCC (0.789, 3 seeds) differ from Vanilla (0.780, 3 seeds) by less than one standard deviation. Blocking gradient flow, however, causes significant degradation: Detach OCC (0.746, 3 seeds) falls 3.4 percentage points below Vanilla. This asymmetry---gradient-flow conditions near Vanilla, gradient-blocked condition well below---indicates that gradient flow is a necessary condition for an auxiliary head to avoid harming collision avoidance.

\textbf{Label content is secondary.} Full OCC and Random OCC differ by 0.8 percentage points in CAR (0.797 vs.\ 0.789), a gap within cross-seed variance ($\sigma \approx 0.031$). Random binary labels---containing no spatial information---match structured occupancy labels in collision avoidance, consistent with gradient flow presence rather than spatial content as the operative factor.

\textbf{Gradient-flow advantage is checkpoint-sensitive.} At an earlier checkpoint (step 47{,}500), Full OCC and Vanilla yield identical mean CAR (0.780), suggesting that the CAR advantage of gradient-flow conditions emerges late in training and is sensitive to checkpoint selection. The ordering (Full OCC $>$ Random OCC $>$ Vanilla $>$ Detach OCC) is consistent at both checkpoints, but the magnitude of the gradient-flow--Vanilla gap depends on the evaluation point.

\textbf{TSR is stable for gradient-flow conditions but unstable under Detach.} For non-Detach conditions, TSR ranges from 0.869 (Random OCC) to 0.915 (Cutoff\textsuperscript{\dag}), with standard deviations $\leq 0.050$. Detaching gradients destabilizes task execution: Detach OCC achieves mean TSR of 0.812 with $\sigma = 0.163$---an order of magnitude higher variance than any other condition. One Detach seed (seed 44) exhibits broad performance collapse (TSR = 0.624), with all ten tasks degraded relative to the other two Detach seeds (0.914, 0.898). This collapse affects action prediction uniformly (CAR remains 0.748, comparable to the other seeds), suggesting that gradient detachment amplifies sensitivity to initialization for motor learning while leaving collision behavior intact.

All values are means across seeds; $\pm$ indicates one standard deviation. Conditions are ordered by CAR within each group. $^\dagger$Cutoff uses 2 seeds; all other conditions use 3--4 seeds. \subsection{Mechanism Analysis}
\label{sec:mechanism}

The four completed conditions form a $2 \times 2$ factorial structure crossing gradient flow (ON/OFF) with label content (structured/random or none). Table~\ref{tab:factorial} arranges the CAR values in this matrix.

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\caption{Factorial decomposition of CAR by gradient flow and label content. Each cell shows the condition name and mean CAR. Vanilla (no auxiliary head) occupies the ``Gradient OFF / Random or no labels'' cell as the natural baseline for both factors.}
\label{tab:factorial}
\begin{tabular}{lcc}
\toprule

\midrule
Structured labels    & Full OCC (0.797) & Detach OCC (0.746) \\

\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\textbf{Gradient flow prevents auxiliary-head degradation.} The column effect---gradient ON minus gradient OFF---is $+$5.1 percentage points with structured labels (Full OCC 0.797 vs.\ Detach OCC 0.746) and $+$0.9 percentage points with random or no labels (Random OCC 0.789 vs.\ Vanilla 0.780). Gradient flow is thus a necessary condition for auxiliary heads to avoid harming collision avoidance.

\textbf{Label content contributes marginally.} The row effect---structured minus random/none---is $+$0.8pp when gradient flows (Full OCC 0.797 vs.\ Random OCC 0.789) and $-$3.4pp when it does not (Detach OCC 0.746 vs.\ Vanilla 0.780). \textbf{Detach incurs a forward-pass cost without gradient compensation.} The asymmetry in gradient flow effects ($+$5.1pp with structured labels vs.\ $+$0.9pp with random/none) reflects the specific penalty of the Detach condition. Detach OCC and Vanilla both lack encoder gradients from the auxiliary loss, but Detach still runs the auxiliary head in the forward pass, introducing BatchNorm statistics that the encoder cannot adapt to without auxiliary gradients. This forward-pass interference without compensating gradient signal explains why Detach falls \emph{below} Vanilla rather than matching it.

\subsection{Main Results}
\label{sec:main_results}

We report mean and standard deviation across $N$ seeds per condition, with 50 rollouts per task (500 total episodes per seed). \textbf{Label content is secondary.} Full OCC and Random OCC differ by 0.8 percentage points in CAR (0.797 vs.\ 0.789), a gap within cross-seed variance ($\sigma \approx 0.031$). \textbf{Gradient-flow advantage is checkpoint-sensitive.} At an earlier checkpoint (step 47{,}500), Full OCC and Vanilla yield identical mean CAR (0.780), suggesting that the CAR advantage of gradient-flow conditions emerges late in training and is sensitive to checkpoint selection. The ordering (Full OCC $>$ Random OCC $>$ Vanilla $>$ Detach OCC) is consistent at both checkpoints, but the magnitude of the gradient-flow--Vanilla gap depends on the evaluation point.

\textbf{Gradient flow prevents auxiliary-head degradation.} The column effect---gradient ON minus gradient OFF---is $+$5.1 percentage points with structured labels (Full OCC 0.797 vs.\ Detach OCC 0.746) and $+$0.9 percentage points with random or no labels (Random OCC 0.789 vs.\ Vanilla 0.780). \section{Results}
\label{sec:results}

\subsection{Main Results}
\label{sec:main_results}

We report mean and standard deviation across $N$ seeds per condition, with 50 rollouts per task (500 total episodes per seed). Given the limited seed counts (2--4 per condition), we supplement point estimates with bootstrap 95\% confidence intervals (CIs) computed via 10{,}000 hierarchical resamples (percentile method) to quantify uncertainty in mean CAR. All results use the 50{,}000-step checkpoint unless noted otherwise.

Table~\ref{tab:main_results} summarizes overall TSR and CAR across conditions. Four patterns emerge.

\textbf{Gradient flow is necessary to prevent auxiliary-head degradation.} Adding an auxiliary head with gradient flow yields CAR comparable to Vanilla: Full OCC (0.797, 3 seeds) and Random OCC (0.789, 3 seeds) exceed Vanilla (0.780, 3 seeds) by less than one standard deviation. The Full OCC $\Delta$CAR of $+$1.7pp is directionally positive but not statistically significant (bootstrap 95\% CI for the pairwise difference includes zero). Blocking gradient flow causes statistically significant degradation: Detach OCC (0.746, 3 seeds) falls 3.4 percentage points below Vanilla, and bootstrap 95\% CIs for all pairwise differences between Detach OCC and other conditions exclude zero. This asymmetry (gradient-flow conditions near Vanilla, gradient-blocked condition well below) indicates that gradient flow is a necessary condition for an auxiliary head to avoid harming collision avoidance.

\textbf{Label content is secondary.} Full OCC and Random OCC differ by 0.8 percentage points in CAR (0.797 vs.\ 0.789), a gap within cross-seed variance ($\sigma \approx 0.031$). Random binary labels---containing no spatial information---match structured occupancy labels in collision avoidance, consistent with gradient flow presence rather than spatial content as the operative factor.

\textbf{Gradient-flow advantage is checkpoint-sensitive.} At an earlier checkpoint (step 47{,}500), Full OCC and Vanilla yield identical mean CAR (0.780), suggesting that the CAR advantage of gradient-flow conditions emerges late in training and is sensitive to checkpoint selection. The ordering (Full OCC $>$ Random OCC $>$ Vanilla $>$ Detach OCC) is consistent at both checkpoints, but the magnitude of the gradient-flow--Vanilla gap depends on the evaluation point.

\textbf{TSR is stable for gradient-flow conditions but unstable under Detach.} For non-Detach conditions, TSR ranges from 0.869 (Random OCC) to 0.915 (Cutoff\textsuperscript{\dag}), with standard deviations $\leq 0.050$. Detaching gradients destabilizes task execution: Detach OCC achieves mean TSR of 0.812 with $\sigma = 0.163$---an order of magnitude higher variance than any other condition. One Detach seed (seed 44) exhibits broad performance collapse (TSR = 0.624), with all ten tasks degraded relative to the other two Detach seeds (0.914, 0.898). This collapse affects action prediction uniformly (CAR remains 0.748, comparable to the other seeds), suggesting that gradient detachment amplifies sensitivity to initialization for motor learning while leaving collision behavior intact.

\subsection{Mechanism Analysis}
\label{sec:mechanism}

The four completed conditions form a $2 \times 2$ factorial structure crossing gradient flow (ON/OFF) with label content (structured/random or none). Table~\ref{tab:factorial} arranges the CAR values in this matrix.

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\caption{Factorial decomposition of CAR by gradient flow and label content. Each cell shows the condition name and mean CAR. The column effect (gradient flow) dominates: both ON cells exceed their OFF counterparts. Vanilla (no auxiliary head) occupies the ``Gradient OFF / Random or no labels'' cell as the natural baseline for both factors.}
\label{tab:factorial}
\begin{tabular}{lcc}
\toprule
 & Gradient ON & Gradient OFF \\
\midrule
Structured labels    & Full OCC (0.797) & Detach OCC (0.746) \\
Random / no labels   & Random OCC (0.789) & Vanilla (0.780) \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\textbf{Gradient flow prevents auxiliary-head degradation.} The column effect---gradient ON minus gradient OFF---is $+$5.1 percentage points with structured labels (Full OCC 0.797 vs.\ Detach OCC 0.746) and $+$0.9 percentage points with random or no labels (Random OCC 0.789 vs.\ Vanilla 0.780). The dominant pattern is not that gradient flow \emph{improves} CAR above Vanilla, but that its \emph{absence} degrades CAR below Vanilla: Detach OCC falls 3.4pp below Vanilla, while gradient-flow conditions remain within 1.7pp of it. Gradient flow is thus a necessary condition for auxiliary heads to avoid harming collision avoidance.

\textbf{Label content contributes marginally.} The row effect---structured minus random/none---is $+$0.8pp when gradient flows (Full OCC 0.797 vs.\ Random OCC 0.789) and $-$3.4pp when it does not (Detach OCC 0.746 vs.\ Vanilla 0.780). With gradient flow, structured labels provide a negligible advantage over random labels (0.8pp, well within $\sigma \approx 0.031$). Without gradient flow, structured labels are associated with worse performance, but this comparison conflates label content with the forward-pass interference specific to the Detach architecture (Section~\ref{sec:why_detach}).

\textbf{Detach incurs a forward-pass cost without gradient compensation.} The asymmetry in gradient flow effects ($+$5.1pp with structured labels vs.\ $+$0.9pp with random/none) reflects the specific penalty of the Detach condition. Detach OCC and Vanilla both lack encoder gradients from the auxiliary loss, but Detach still runs the auxiliary head in the forward pass, introducing BatchNorm statistics that the encoder cannot adapt to without auxiliary gradients. This forward-pass interference without compensating gradient signal explains why Detach falls \emph{below} Vanilla rather than matching it.

\textbf{Detaching gradients destabilizes action learning.} Beyond CAR degradation, Detach OCC exhibits uniquely high TSR variance ($\sigma = 0.163$, vs.\ $< 0.050$ for all other conditions). One Detach seed (seed~44) shows TSR = 0.624 with uniform degradation across all ten tasks, while its CAR (0.748) remains comparable to the other two seeds (0.746, 0.744). This dissociation---intact collision behavior with collapsed task execution---suggests that gradient detachment amplifies optimization instability for action prediction specifically, consistent with the encoder bearing forward-pass interference from the auxiliary head without receiving compensating gradient signal.

Three candidate mechanisms---anti-overfitting regularization, loss landscape smoothing, and gradient diversity---can account for the gradient flow effect. All three predict that gradient flow is necessary and label content is secondary. Section~\ref{sec:why_gradient} develops these hypotheses; the current data cannot distinguish between them.

\label{sec:per_task}

Detach OCC is systematically the worst on Task~3 (CAR 0.11 vs.\ 0.31--0.38 for all other conditions), consistent with gradient detachment amplifying degradation on physically constrained tasks. \subsection{Temporal Dynamics}
\label{sec:temporal}

The Cutoff condition applies occupancy supervision with gradient flow for the first 35{,}000 training steps, then disables the auxiliary loss for the remaining 15{,}000 steps. This condition tests whether the gradient flow effect requires continuous auxiliary supervision or whether early-phase exposure is sufficient.

\textbf{Cutoff partially preserves the gradient flow effect.} Cutoff achieves CAR of 0.783 (2 seeds), falling between Vanilla (0.780) and Full OCC (0.797) but closer to Vanilla ($+$0.3pp vs.\ Vanilla, compared to Full OCC's $+$1.7pp). Removing auxiliary gradients for the final 30\% of training erodes most of the CAR advantage that continuous gradient flow provides, suggesting that the encoder partially reverts toward action-specialized features when auxiliary gradients are withdrawn.

\textbf{Cutoff remains well above Detach.} The 3.7pp gap between Cutoff (0.783) and Detach OCC (0.746) indicates that 35{,}000 steps of gradient flow provide substantial and partially durable protection against the degradation observed under full gradient detachment. The early-phase auxiliary gradients establish encoder representations that do not fully collapse when the auxiliary signal is removed, even though they do not maintain the full benefit of continuous gradient flow.

\textbf{Early-phase training durably improves task completion.} Cutoff achieves the highest TSR among all conditions (0.915 vs.\ 0.907 Vanilla, 0.894 Full OCC), suggesting that 35{,}000 steps of auxiliary gradient flow provide a lasting benefit to action prediction that persists---and may even improve---when auxiliary gradients are subsequently removed. This TSR--CAR dissociation reveals distinct temporal requirements: task completion benefits durably from early-phase auxiliary training, while collision avoidance requires continuous gradient flow to be maintained.

\textbf{Hard tasks expose the cost of removing late-stage gradient flow.} On Task~5, Cutoff achieves CAR of 0.00 across both seeds---the worst performance of any condition on any task, including Detach (0.05). Full OCC (0.17) and Random OCC (0.23) achieve non-zero T5 CAR with continuous gradient flow. This complete failure on the hardest safety task under early-only gradient flow indicates that collision avoidance on physically constrained tasks depends on auxiliary gradients throughout training, not only during the initial learning phase. On Task~3, Cutoff achieves the highest CAR of any condition (0.66), demonstrating that the temporal sensitivity is task-specific rather than uniform. Cutoff uses 2 seeds; a third seed is in progress.


\subsection{Depth vs.\ BEV Occupancy}
\label{sec:depth_results}

The Depth condition replaces BEV occupancy supervision with egocentric monocular depth prediction (Section~\ref{sec:depth_head}), holding the auxiliary training mechanism constant---same architecture, same loss weight schedule, same gradient flow through DINOv2 and SigLIP encoders. This comparison isolates whether the spatial reference frame or the type of spatial information affects the gradient flow effect, using 4 seeds (42, 43, 44, 45) for additional statistical power.

\textbf{Depth matches Vanilla exactly.} Depth achieves mean CAR of 0.780 $\pm$ 0.039 across 4 seeds---identical to Vanilla (0.780 $\pm$ 0.012). \textbf{Depth falls below both OCC conditions.} The ordering Full OCC (0.797) $>$ Random OCC (0.789) $>$ Cutoff (0.783) $>$ Depth (0.780) $=$ Vanilla (0.780) places Depth at the bottom of the gradient-flow conditions. \textbf{Depth exhibits high cross-seed variance on hard tasks.} On Task~3, Depth CAR ranges from 0.20 to 0.78 across 4 seeds (mean 0.50); on Task~6, it ranges from 0.16 to 0.84 (mean 0.54). This variance exceeds that of other conditions on the same tasks and is consistent with the broader finding that auxiliary supervision amplifies seed sensitivity relative to Vanilla ($\sigma = 0.012$).
